item.title: Using Custom Fonts on a Page
item.description: 1. Font-family The fonts you can use on a web page are limited to the handful of fonts already installed on the PC the browser is running on. Windows operating system, Chinese fonts: SimHei (Hei) SimSun (Song) NSimSun (New Song) FangSong (FangSong) KaiTi (Kai) FangSongGB2312 (FangSong GB2312) KaiTiGB2312 (Kai GB2312)
